text: Jordan presented a dashboard redesign that Marcus praised as "the right direction," with Lena signaling her approval too, and the relief of finally trusting their own design instincts instead of second-guessing Marcus left them feeling lighter than they had in weeks. Afterward Jordan celebrated at Groundwork, making solid progress on Coda by getting the quick-start cards working with real stored data, and Lena's follow-up text of encouragement landed especially meaningfully. Jordan ended the day feeling settled and content, deciding that this sense of having things "approximately together" is enough.
